plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Forcepoint firewall. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, fan, power supply status, sessions/connections, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 47565).
name: Firewall

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Per-core CPU utilisation of the Forcepoint NGFW (STONESOFT-FIREWALL-MIB fwCpuTotal, averaged).

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the Forcepoint NGFW in bytes (fwMemBytesTotal).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used memory of the Forcepoint NGFW in bytes (fwMemBytesUsed).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilisation of the Forcepoint NGFW, derived as used/total.

metrics.name: firewall_active_sessions
metrics.description: Number of current connections on the Forcepoint NGFW (FORCEPOINT-NGFW-ENGINE-MIB fwConnNumber). A rapid rise can indicate a connection flood or session-table pressure.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Hardware temperature sensor reading of the Forcepoint NGFW in degrees Celsius (FORCEPOINT-NGFW-ENGINE-MIB fwHwTemperature). Abnormally high values may indicate fan failure, poor airflow, or high ambient temperature.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Forcepoint NGFW power supply (FORCEPOINT-NGFW-ENGINE-MIB fwPsuStatus, FwHwComponentStatus), normalized so that 1 means ok and 2 means bad (notPresent/warning/error/fatalError).

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Forcepoint NGFW cooling fan (FORCEPOINT-NGFW-ENGINE-MIB fwFanStatus, FwHwComponentStatus), normalized so that 1 means ok and 2 means bad (notPresent/warning/error/fatalError).

metrics.name: device_fan_rpm
metrics.description: Rotational speed of each Forcepoint NGFW cooling fan in RPM (FORCEPOINT-NGFW-ENGINE-MIB fwFan).
